info.description: bee — config-driven AI dev CLI. All secrets live in MongoDB, never in the binary.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Plan create/show/next/claim/update/comment using an existing registered session

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --file
options.description: create/comment: bounded UTF-8 file, or - for stdin

options.name: --summary-file
options.description: update: bounded UTF-8 summary, or - for stdin

options.name: --revision
options.description: Expected immutable definition revision (1)

options.name: --if-version
options.description:
Optional exact aggregate version; conflicts
instead of retrying newer versions

options.name: --lease-seconds
options.description:
claim/renew: 30-300 seconds, capped by the
registered session lease

options.name: --state
options.description:
update:
running|blocked|failed|abandoned|reported_complete
|renew. Completion requires a summary and is not
QA acceptance

options.name: --limit
options.description:
next: 1-5 complete steps (default 1); children:
1-5 child summaries (default 5)

options.name: --after
options.description:
children: exclusive plan ID cursor returned as
nextAfter; optional STEP_ID filters the origin
step

arguments.name: ACTION
arguments.description:
create|show|next|children|claim|update|comment. Uses an
existing authenticated collaboration session

commands.name: remember
commands.description:
Persistent memory (decisions/errors/learnings). Bare text saves;
'context/search/stats/history' query

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --type
options.description:
decision | error | learning | pattern (default:
learning)

options.name: --alternative
options.description:
An option considered and rejected, as "option: why
not". Repeatable

options.name: --tags
options.description: Comma-separated tags

options.name: --path
options.description:
The files this fact is about (repeatable). Anchors
it: 'bee lint' on a matching file surfaces it

options.name: --json
options.description:
Emit a stable machine-readable shape instead of a
table

options.name: --before
options.description:
Only memories learned before this: 7d, 24h, or a date
like 2026-08-01

options.name: --semantic
options.description:
Rank by embedding (cosine) similarity instead of
token match

options.name: --since
options.description: History window, e.g. 7d, 24h, 30m

options.name: --root
options.description:
Checked-out repository root the audit inspects
(read-only)

options.name: --with
options.description: The memory id that supersedes the named one

options.name: --with-evidence
options.description:
Opt-in lifecycle/source-evidence metadata in the
context envelope

options.name: --source
options.description:
A checkout-relative file whose current bytes become a
source anchor (repeatable, for 'evidence add')

arguments.name: ACTION
arguments.description: A verb (context/search/stats/history) or the content to save

arguments.name: CONTENT
arguments.description: Content when the first arg is a verb like 'search'

arguments.name: ID
arguments.description:
The memory id for verbs with a subcommand (e.g. 'evidence add
<id>')
